verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents opening pull requests (via `cafe stack submit` and the CLI) and reviews that rulesets can require. Its homepage claims you can "compare diffs, and leave feedback alongside the code," and PR reviews and comments are first-class objects that are imported from GitHub and exposed via MCP. missing for 10: dedicated docs describing the inline review-comment and diff-view workflow (the evidence is a single marketing line), independent or hands-on corroboration.
